name: Accessible Learning Visual Series

identity.voice: profesional, cercana, rigurosa y prudente con las afirmaciones
identity.visual_character: editorial contemporáneo, alto contraste, estructura clara e iconografía corporativa contenida

audience: PyMEs que evalúan alternativas digitales accesibles
educational_purpose: Explicar decisiones de diseño de aprendizaje mediante visuales verificables, accesibles y ampliables, sin confundir interacción o analítica con evidencia automática de aprendizaje.

policies.standards_exception: Official standards may be older when still current.

locked_decisions.decision: The latest approved infographic controls the palette.
Spanish is primary; short technical labels may be English.
The system is approved once and then runs autonomously within the series.
Pause only for material identity changes, insufficient evidence or accessibility failure.
Never commit private Canva edit links.
